items.title: Trump Media wants to clear $884 million of debt without selling its bitcoin
items.summary: The Truth Social owner bought back $100 million of convertible notes this week.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows show waning crypto appetite ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut
Bitcoin holds above $63,750 but Fed rate-hike threats loom large
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw more than $300 million in outflows Wednesday, with attention now turning to Anthrophic's $100 billion IPO.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin plunges to lowest since July as Anthropic gains, but broader markets tumble
items.summary: The Nasdaq, S&P 500, and DJIA all fell by more than 2% on Thursday as Anthropic rose about 16% from its IPO price.

items.title: Bitcoin miner that sold its last BTC warns it may run short of cash for $1.2 billion AI deal
items.summary: Hyperscale Data needs another $74.8 million to complete its Michigan data center project, even after selling its remaining bitcoin and raising fresh debt.

items.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
items.summary: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

items.title: Ações MSTR financiam nova compra de Bitcoin da Strategy
items.summary: A Strategy comprou 1.665 Bitcoin com ações MSTR e elevou sua reserva de Bitcoin para 847.666 BTC, mantendo a liderança corporativa.

items.title: Juros e petróleo pressionam Bitcoin; Zcash cai 12%
items.summary: Bitcoin recua com a alta dos Treasuries e do petróleo, enquanto Zcash lidera as perdas e GRT avança no mercado cripto nesta terça-feira.
